title: Timeouts, retries and backoff with jitter
supports: Caller waiting, extra retry load and effect safety. The finite Java workload, timings and tie rules are original illustrative choices, not AWS measurements or SDK behavior.

title: Exponential Backoff and Jitter
supports: Motivation for varying retry delays and workload-dependent comparison. No vendor code, graphs or universal jitter improvement claim is copied.

title: Handling Overload
relevantSections: Handling overload errors; deciding to retry
supports: Bounded retry policy and ownership. The modeled finite batch budget is distinct from the chapter's per-client retry ratio and other production policies.

title: Deadlines
relevantSections: Deadlines on the client; deadlines on the server; deadline propagation
supports: Distinguishes client deadlines, RPC cancellation and server application responsibility for stopping spawned work. The Java model does not implement gRPC or cancellation.
